description: Hawaii Performance Monitoring System (HPMS) Roads is a dataset listed in Hawaii Department of Transportation open data portal (highways.hidot.hawaii.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Hawaii Department of Transportation. HPMS (Highway Performance Monitoring System Roads for Hawaii - 2024. Submitted to FHWA, June 2025); Street centerlines with selected attribute information extracted by Hawaii State DOT staff from the HPMS database for Hawaii for use in the Hawaii Statewide GIS database. Source: Hawaii State Department of Transportation, September 22, 2025. Coverage: Hawaii. The table has 25 columns. The portal shows 2025-11-26 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-highways-hidot-hawaii-gov-portal.
